name: Weapon Master
description:
You gain the following benefits.
	**Ability Score Increase**: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
	**Mastery Property**: Your training with weapons allows you to use the [mastery property](note:weapon-masteries) of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kind of weapon to another eligible kind.
